prompts.A: Create a finished wide 16:9 YouTube cover for a US deep-ocean natural history documentary. An uncanny but biologically grounded Erenna siphonophore fishing lure. From black water on the right emerges a hair-fine translucent ivory tentillum which bends down to a single fleshy, glowing cherry-red tear-shaped lure. A small photoreal silvery lanternfish on the lower left-center peers across a tiny gap at the red point, its big reflective eye and jaws in crisp close-up. Capture the suspense BEFORE a possible encounter, no swallowing, no violence. The lure is attached to a visible delicate organic filament leading to a softly lit gelatinous colony disappearing off the right edge. No anglerfish, no teeth monsters, no hook, no diver. Premium blackwater macro photography aesthetic, jet-black cobalt water, glassy skin and minute photophores, a controlled cool rim light catches the eye, red reflected in the eye, no fantasy rainbow. Make the red point and fish eye unmistakable at 160px. Bold editorial typography set into real dark negative space in the upper left, safe from edges: exactly "WHY" over "RED?" with WHY in warm ivory and RED? in rich amber, strong compact heavyweight sans. This is the only text. Mobile-safe margin 7%, lower right clear for time badge. Edge-to-edge continuous image with no border, graphic panels, arrows, watermark or logo.
prompts.B: Create an original wide 16:9 finished thumbnail for a US blackwater wildlife documentary, photographic reconstruction rather than a diagram. A single free-floating physonect siphonophore sweeps diagonally across the left two thirds in a bold, graceful hook shape. Clearly show multiple transparent swimming bells, staggered along ONE continuous thin living stem like a row of glass thimbles, with a few rosy internal canals; transition below into amber feeding zooids and fine trailing tentacles. Frame close enough to see tissue, tiny specular highlights and the dark water through the bells. The curve should read almost like one strange creature at first, then separate workers become distinct. Hero subject big, silhouette clean, dramatic silvery ice blue rim and warm coral internal tissue against deep navy-black. Natural ROV side light, very sparse marine snow. No eyes or mouth on the bells, no giant jellyfish cap, no skeleton, no bioluminescent neon chains, no sea floor. Place a large, impeccably legible stacked heading in the naturally dark middle right area, exact text "WHO'S" in warm white and "STEERING?" in amber, condensed heavy sans, wide margins, away from the bottom-right duration badge. No other words, numerals, logo, lines, border, icons or UI. It should look striking in a lineup at phone size and invite a question about steering a colony. Horizontal landscape composition.
